name: bar stool chair
caption: A bar stool chair with a small seat, a low back and four tall legs. A square seat joins four legs; a slatted backrest rises between the rear legs. Flat seat and back panels keep a constant thickness with squared legs. Overall width is 0.95 times depth; height is 2.10 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous charcoal, cream, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
